column1: # The game's counts that only a Collection Log page shows, read as the page opens: page<TAB>slot<TAB>label<TAB>card.
# page is the page's key (its name as ClogService.bossToCategory keys it). slot is the varp that carries the line:
# 1 COLLECTION_CATEGORY_COUNT, 2 COLLECTION_CATEGORY_COUNT2, 3 COLLECTION_CATEGORY_COUNT3, as the game's page script
# writes it ([proc,collection_category_count], osrs-dumps 11/3). label is the line as the game writes it, up to its
# colon; it is also the count's name in the sync. card is the label of the count's own line under the card's lead
# (a raid's Entry, a page whose lead is the hiscores' count), else -: the count leads the page's card, as the game's
# page does. One row per page: a card shows the first row for its page. Only lines the page script draws from these
# three varps can be rows: Gnome Restaurant's deliveries come from varbits of their own, so they aren't read.
# The choice of lines is Dylan's (11/6, 11/13).
